result.title: HOForce: Motion and Force Reconstruction of Hand-Object Interaction Using a Single-View RGB-D Video
result.summary: Reconstructing hand-object interactions is an important task, and achieving it with a single camera makes large-scale capture practical but challenging due to heavy occlusions. We introduce HOForce to track hands and objects, and further recover interaction forces from single-view RGB-D video and known object properties. For two-hand manipulation, we jointly model fingertip forces of both hands and the contact forces between objects when two objects are presented. The reconstructed forces also improve motion tracking by giving pose constraints in the occluded regions. HOForce recovers hand and object motion more accurately on DexYCB and TACO and produces less hand-object penetration than interaction baselines on DexYCB. On our dataset of fingertip forces recorded with tactile sensors, HOForce reduces normal-force MAE by 24.5% relative to the strongest baseline. The recovered forces reproduce object motion in MuJoCo and transfer to other engines after adaptation.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 HOForce，从单视角 RGB-D 视频与已知物体属性重建手-物体交互，同时联合估计指尖力与物体间接触力，并用恢复的力作为遮挡区域的姿态约束来改善跟踪。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是物理接触力与手物运动的三维重建，力仅作为物理量被估计并回馈几何跟踪，不涉及 VLM 的 latent 推理状态、证据筛选或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 类决策，与主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
